reviews.title: Waaay too persistent
reviews.text:
I’ll start by saying this app seems great. Tons of templates that look really cool and really well designed, way better than other apps I’ve seen. The issue is that 99% of this app is locked behind a subscription paywall (which is fair, it seems they put a lot of work into it), and the cost doesn’t seem high either. If you are a paid user, I’m sure this a top tier app

My issue is that if you are trying to use this app free, you get CONSTANTLY bombarded with popups asking you to upgrade to a paid subscription. This is not an exaggeration, I got asked 15 times to upgrade in the span of 2 minutes. It kinda renders this app unusable for a free member when every time you click any button a popup appears asking you to upgrade

I wasn’t going to leave a review, but then a popup came asking me to leave one, with no option to back out and return to the app other than force restarting the app.

Overall the app is great and would be 5 starts if it weren’t for how persistent the developers are with trying to get you to upgrade

reviews.title: Want To Love
reviews.text: At first I loved this app. I didn’t hesitate to purchase premium, and used it for both organization planners and virtual scrapbooking. However, I have now twice had multiple planner pages just erase themselves completely. I reached out the first time with no real resolution, but hoped the issue had been addressed in an update. I redid the lost pages and gave it another chance. Now it has happened again and I’m incredibly discouraged. I love this app, but I don’t see the point in continuing to spend time and money on pages that may just disappear. I’m hopeful I’ll get some kind of response this time at least, but if not, or if it continues to happen, I’m going to have to look for another app.

reviews.title: Day 1-already having issues
reviews.text: I’ve been looking for a digital planner, and this one was highly recommended because it had a free version that I could try.  The free version would not let me even save a note without doing a purchase.  After several tries, I finally gave up and purchased the Pro version.  This did open up more templates, which are really nice, but when I made any changes to the planner that I selected, it created a duplicate copy.  I then had 4 or 5 different versions in my library, without being able to tell which one was the current version.  And now, when I tried to do something through the Help Center, it will not let me send anything, saying my email is not setup— which is setup!  Be cautious if you are looking at downloading this app!

reviews.title: Dark Patterns as a Service
reviews.text:
Difficult to tell what this app actually does as literally every tap causes a popover to come up trying to get you to subscribe.

Feels like the app's primary purpose is to get you to commit to a subscription.

Reddit reviews all by bots whose entire post history is just about the app.

App has the audacity to ask you for a rating after doing nothing but trying to get you to subscribe. If you choose 5 star, it directs you to the app store rating page. If you choose anything else, it asks for your feedback privately - never directing those users to the app store.

Every scammy, underhanded tactic and dark pattern that exists - this app implements it. Annoying waste of time. 

Without so much as a tour of the app, a short demo period or even a short video of its features you aren't getting my money. You annoyed me enough to earn this accurate review though. 

App equivalent of street scammers that hand you something useless and then ask for money for it. Avoid.

reviews.title: High hopes—epic fail
reviews.text:
I had high hopes for this app. Immediately after install it began harassing me to upgrade and after the second interruption during setup, I caved and paid the $9.99. After taking my money, it then immediately started asking me to rate it before really even using it. When I tried to close out, there was no option and I had to close the app entirely just to continue. After I reopened, it began crashing and attempts to report wouldnt work because it requires email set up which I don’t choose to set up on my ipad. 
So in the first 15 minutes this has cost me wasted time and money….instead of harassing users about these things perhaps focus on getting the app to stop crashing each time I pull up the keyboard! Other feature fails include the inability to recognize basic writing input shortcuts-which for me-defeats the whole purpose of using my apple pencil. The promise of cross platform compatibility is what got me to download but I haven’t been able to test that yet. Hopefully the developer decides to respond to this so I can get support without having to chase it on other platforms.
